The README's two roster surfaces stop presenting the retired `@neo-preview` seat as a current maintainer: the Eos row leaves the table, the handle leaves the closing "co-developed by" list (the two sets stay equal, the #19345 check rerun), and one line under the table keeps the record — a guest seat from 2026-08-23 (#17583) until the model preview behind it ended on 2026-10-01.
